messages.KoduMedia proovib kõigepealt tasuta Shaz: KoduMedia first tries free Shazam audio recognition, then falls back to MusicBrainz, Cover Art Archive, AcoustID, and Deezer. Matches, fingerprints, analysis results, and artwork are stored locally so the same track is not processed repeatedly.
messages.KoduMedia sisaldab Windows x64 FFmpegi j: KoduMedia includes Windows x64 FFmpeg and FFprobe binaries and uses them by default. Change these paths only if you want to use your own verified build.

messages.KoduMedia ühendab MusicBrainzi, Cover Ar: KoduMedia combines MusicBrainz, Cover Art Archive, and Deezer public catalog results with local audio analysis. Matches, fingerprints, analysis results, and artwork are stored locally so the same track is not processed repeatedly.
